parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: The wheel is a small metallic part located at the top of the lighter, typically made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to create friction against the flint, generating sparks to ignite the fuel.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates when the user rolls it with their thumb to produce a spark.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the lighter, typically made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fuel reservoir and internal components, providing structure and grip for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the main support for other moving parts.
